verdict.rationale: Superhuman's own Snippets feature inserts commonly used phrases, paragraphs, or whole emails with a keyboard shortcut, and snippets can be shared with a team, so the core reusable-reply capability is documented. The story also asks for variables and attachments, and nothing in the evidence shows either. Missing for 10: documented variable/placeholder substitution in snippets, attaching files to snippets, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply

citations.quote: With Snippets, you can automate typing and push past this limit. Insert commonly-used phrases, paragraphs, or whole emails with a simple keyboard shortcut.
You can also share Snippets with your team, so your team can move faster, with consistent, up-to-date, and high-performing messaging.
